eval-bot: [ALERT] Nightly eval failed: instruct-qa-suite on model redwood-v2-3b-q4_0 (run 2026-06-12 03:05 UTC). Failure summary: accuracy down 12% vs baseline. Trigger: quantized nightly.

anika: @maria @kevin looks bad, what's the initial severity? any idea if this is infra or model?

maria: quick glance — failure concentrated on Yes/No and extraction prompts. few-shot accuracy 64% -> 52% (delta -12). Most failing cases are hallucinations or truncated completions.

kevin: was this a new quant config? q4_0 changed last deploy?

maria: it's the q4_0 variant. last quant push was 3 days ago (PR #948) but performance was green in staging. Nightly uses stock promptset with longer context (up to 512).

sam: I'll reproduce locally. command I'll run:
```
python eval/run_suite.py --suite instruct-qa --model redwood-v2-3b-q4_0 --seed 42 --shots 5
```

maria: adding a couple of sample failing inputs/outputs from the run:
Input: "Who wrote 'Pride and Prejudice'?"
Expected: "Jane Austen"
Output: "It was written by a friend of the Austen family, commonly thought to be Jane Austen."

Input: "List the ingredients of a margarita"
Expected: "tequila, triple sec, lime"
Output: "Tequila, OJ, and a dash of bitters."

anika: :eyes: those are classic hallucinations and cocktail mixup — maybe vocab/embedding mapping shifted due to quant kernel?

kevin: can you capture the logits / token probabilities around the hallucinated tokens? that helps check quant noise.

maria: attaching quick log snippets (truncated):
```
Token probs near 'Jane': 0.02, 'Austen': 0.01, 'friend': 0.12
KV cache similarity spikes at step 18
```

sam: reproducible locally. severity P2 for now. Accuracy drop is significant but not catastrophic. Recommend: 1) run targeted eval with longer context, 2) compare float32 baseline on same seed, 3) collect full token probs and kv diffs, 4) open incident issue and tag quant infra.

anika: owners: @sam repro + issue, @maria produce eval artifacts, @kevin investigate quant kernels. I'll ping infra if KV cache looks suspect.

kevin: will look into kernel selection logs and quant rounding thresholds.

maria: will upload full run artifacts to the eval bucket and add pointers in the issue. expecting ~30 min.

sam: created issue #1234: https://redwood/issues/1234 — added initial triage, attachments, and TODOs. marking as P2 and assigning to sam/maria/kevin.

anika: :thumbsup: good plan. If evidence points to regression in q4_0 we may rollback nightly to q4_1 snapshot. Hold deployments until we confirm.

maria: noted. I'll run float baseline and post diff in the issue.

kevin: starting kernel log inspection now.

sam: closing loop for now — will update thread and issue with findings. :white_check_mark:
